svg.title: What the contract tests check against a real Paperless
svg.desc: run-contract.sh starts a real Paperless-ngx, the last release of 2.x or the current release of 3.x, next to Nextcloud. contract.py seeds Paperless through its REST API and checks every answer that the app reads, then the app runs its export, a move, the trash and the inbox against it. The answers of Paperless become the fixtures of the unit tests in tests/fixtures/, which PaperlessApiServiceTest reads; a later run compares their shapes with the fixtures and fails when a field that the tests read is gone. When the app passes in a pull request and the fixtures differ, the fixture bot commits the new fixtures onto its branch, or suggests them on a pull request from a fork. Every Monday a failure opens an issue.
